blocks.title: Business
blocks.text: Dream Payment is a fast-growing fintech company originally headquartered in Canada. As a Series A venture, they were expanding into the U.S. market with plans to compete at the enterprise level.

blocks.title: Problem
blocks.text: As Dream Payment expanded beyond Canada into the U.S. market, they encountered a critical roadblock: their brand identity, website, and product UX weren't built to support enterprise-level growth. These touchpoints didn't reflect the premium positioning expected in the highly competitive U.S. fintech space.

blocks.title: Solution
blocks.text: The transformation was executed through our Brand Engineering process, which was designed to operate autonomously with minimal lift from their internal team.

carousel.title: Discovery
carousel.text: We kicked off the engagement by understanding Dream's current UX, brand challenges, and market expansion goals.

carousel.title: Overhaul of Their Product UX
carousel.text: We designed a user experience flow that aligned with U.S. market expectations and clearly communicated Dream's value to new users and stakeholders.

carousel.title: Design
carousel.text: We applied a modern, premium visual identity across all core assets

carousel.title: Full Website Redesign
carousel.text: U.S. website kicked off on Day 151; final U.S. site designs and the Canada site UI guide delivered on Day 204

carousel.title: Development
carousel.text: All approved designs were handed off for development to ensure continuity and performance across platforms.
